*   **Limitations:** Requires pre-processing (baking) of normal maps and geometry; displacement is quantized to whole voxels for geometry, though lighting uses exact heights [S2, unofficial].

The claim states that the technique requires pre-processing (baking) of normal maps and geometry, and that displacement is quantized to whole voxels for geometry while lighting uses exact heights. Source [S2] explicitly confirms: 1) Pre-processing involves converting triangle meshes into geometry data (which can be baked) and generating normal maps from textures (described as slow and should be baked). 2) The renderer displaces vertices to the nearest whole number of voxels (quantization). 3) The renderer uses exact (non-quantized) height values to calculate normal maps for lighting. All facts in the claim are present in the evidence.
